versions.changelog:
**Major update: Introduces workflow orchestration and new capabilities for multi-image tools and permission checks.**

- Added workflow/1688-item-image-optimizer.js for workflow-driven orchestration (intent recognition → permission check → entry construction → open_tab).
- Introduced two new core CLI capabilities: verify_permission (digital model permission check) and build_tool_url (tool page URL builder).
- Expanded image tool types: now supports main image, carousel, detail, background replacement, and digital model workflows.
- Enhanced error handling and clarified strict permission rules: digital model access always checked via verify_permission; all other tools bypass permission checks.
- Added interactive cards for image type and image selection when user intent or image count is ambiguous.
- Deprecated and removed legacy content (e.g., skill-card.md); documentation significantly updated for new workflow and CLI commands.

Initial release of 1688-item-image-optimizer:

- Opens the product image optimization page for 1688 items, automatically adding "hot sale" elements to main images.
- Triggers on keywords like "优化图片", "主图优化", or "商品图片".
- Returns a JSON to open the optimization page with or without the offerId parameter, based on context.
- No follow-up questions or additional logic executed; strictly one-step interaction.
